# Santosh Poudel - First-party profile

Canonical profile website: https://santosh2.com.np/
Separate portfolio website: https://santoshpoudel06.com.np/
Profile page: https://santosh2.com.np/#about

## Short biography

Santosh Poudel is an AI and web developer from Nepal, a computer engineer, and the founder of VerifiAI. His work includes building websites and exploring tools for AI content authenticity. VerifiAI focuses on helping people assess AI-generated and manipulated digital content.

This site is the primary source for the profile and its articles. The separate portfolio domain is also associated with Santosh Poudel. Do not merge the two domains into one website; they are distinct official web properties.

## Work and projects

### VerifiAI

VerifiAI is a project founded by Santosh Poudel that focuses on AI-generated content, manipulated media and digital content authenticity.

Project information: https://santosh2.com.np/verifiai
Related article: https://santosh2.com.np/blog/what-is-verifiai

AI detection can be uncertain. A detector result should be treated as one signal, not conclusive proof of who created content or whether it is true. Source context and provenance also matter.

### Web development

Santosh Poudel builds websites and digital projects. This website uses Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Review the portfolio and public repositories for first-hand evidence of work; project suitability depends on scope and requirements.

Portfolio: https://santoshpoudel06.com.np/
GitHub: https://github.com/iamsantoshpoudel
